note: Adapted from Holmgren's 1910 original German description; the original reads Eutermes castaniceps n. sp.; locality Blumenau, Brazil (collected by Fr. Müller), type in the Berlin Museum; now placed in the genus Diversitermes. The original states that the species is very close to E. diversimiles Silv. and compares the two point by point without giving new diagnostic characters. The soldier occurs in large, medium and small forms, and the original gives a set of measurements for each. The medium soldier's 'head width 0.65—0.64 mm' is printed thus in the original; the two figures are probably transposed.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Very close to E. diversimiles Silv. Head pale chestnut brown, the anterior angles of the transverse band and the antennae rusty yellow; clypeus yellow; thorax and sternites rusty brown, the middle of the sternites straw yellow; wings greyish rusty yellow, veins brown. Head and body with fairly dense short hairs. Head rather long, oval. Compound eyes medium-sized, strongly projecting. Ocelli about their own diameter from the compound eyes, the inner margin of the ocelli strongly raised. Frontal gland pore fairly large, triangular. Muscle impressions as in E. diversimiles. Clypeus about half as long as wide, strongly convex. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 distinctly longer than segment 2, segment 4 equal to segment 2. Pronotum as in diversimiles, width equal to the head width including the compound eyes. Posterior margin of the mesonotum more broadly concave than that of the metanotum. Wings as in diversimiles. Measurements (mm): length with wings 14.5; length without wings 8.5; head length 1.28; head width 1.17.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Large form: head yellow, nasus slightly darker, body straw yellow. Head with very fine hairs and some setae; abdominal tergites with very fine hairs and a posterior row of setae. Head rather long, oval; nasus narrow, nearly cylindrical; frontal outline with scarcely perceptible swelling at the base of the nasus. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 far longer than segment 2, almost twice segment 4, segment 5 equal to segment 2. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave. Measurements: body length 3.5 mm; head length 1.78 mm; head width 0.95 mm.

Medium form: colour and pilosity as in the large form. Head long, sides parallel, scarcely perceptibly constricted behind the antennae; nasus short, straight, cylindrical, with a distinct swelling at its base. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 longer than segment 4, segment 5 longer than segment 4. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave. Measurements: body length 3 mm; head length 1.25—1.28 mm; head width 0.65—0.64 mm (sic).

Small form: head pale yellow, nasus slightly darker, body white. Head with only a few setae; abdominal tergites with only a few microscopic hairs but with a posterior row of setae. Head long, weakly constricted behind the antennae or not constricted; nasus rather long, cylindrical; frontal outline with a distinct swelling at the base of the nasus. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 equal to segment 2, segment 4 longer than segment 3, segment 5 slightly shorter than segment 4. Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave. Measurements: body length 2—2.5 mm; head length 1.07—1.14 mm (the original adds that the most frequent range is 1.1—1.14); head width 0.49—0.54 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellow, body white. Head with scattered hairs; abdominal tergites thinly hairy, the posterior row of setae indistinct. Head broadly oval, head suture invisible. Clypeus half as long as wide. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 equal to segment 3, segment 4 distinctly shorter, segment 5 longer than segment 4. Pronotum distinctly saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave. Measurements (mm): body length 4; head length 1.21; head width 0.95.
